newsitem.title: UK: Thomas Potts unable to buy Anglo's Coalite.
newsitem.headline: Thomas Potts unable to buy Anglo's Coalite.

text.p: Anglo United Plc said on Friday that Britain's Thomas Potts Plc was unable to continue with its planned acquisition of Anglo's smokeless fuels manufacturer Coalite Products Ltd.
Thomas Potts had told Anglo that Rutland Corporate Finance had terminated a placing agreement made on May 29.
"Naturally, the board of Anglo is disappointed with this outcome and will be reviewing its strategy as a result," the company said in a statement.
"In the meantime, the two division of Coalite Products Ltd continue to trade profitably," it added.
Thomas Potts announced in May that it wanted to buy Coalite for 24.3 million pounds and was planning a placing and open offer to finance the purchase.
An extraordinary meeting, held and adjourned on June 23, would now not be reconvened, Anglo said.
